root_cause_label: Excessive Cleanup Deleting Required Task Assets
one_sentence_failure_summary: After successfully building the CLI tool and generating the prediction, the agent deleted the source code (cli_tool.c), all supporting library files, the reference input image (image.png), and the original model files, leaving only the binary and prediction.txt and rendering the solution non-reproducible and unverifiable.
t_err_evidence: At step 28, the agent deletes cli_tool.c (the sole C source file) after claiming the task is done, operating under the false premise that only the compiled binary and prediction.txt need to persist.
t_commit_evidence: Deleting cli_tool.c at step 28 is irreversible within this trajectory; the agent never re-creates the source file and continues deleting additional required assets (model.pth, image.png, libraries) in subsequent steps.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed that having produced a working binary (cli_tool) and prediction.txt constitutes full task completion, treating all other files as disposable cleanup targets. It never considered that benchmarks require a reproducible, source-level implementation and that input assets like image.png must be preserved for re-evaluation.
